newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: PRESS DIGEST - SOUTH KOREAN NEWSPAPERS - AUG 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - SOUTH KOREAN NEWSPAPERS - AUG 12.

text.p: The following is a summary of major stories in leading South Korean newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Seoul. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- Seoul Mayor Cho Soon has decided to run in December's presidential election as the candidate of the smallest opposition Democratic Party.

- The U.S. National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) member George Black said it was not certain whether the fatal crash of Korean Air Lines Boeing 747 in Guam was caused by the pilot or the airport control tower, but that it was the fault of those involved in the landing process.
- Korea's Top-30 chaebols, held a combined total of 64.36 in intersubsidiary debt guarantees as of the end of March, the Fair Trade Commission said.
- Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu will make an offical visit to South Korea August 27 and 28.
